# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `close` MCP server, Close's hosted MCP at `https://mcp.close.com/mcp` (Streamable HTTP, OAuth). There is no API key to configure.
- Added the `close-crm`, `account-brief`, `pipeline-review`, and `follow-up-plan` skills.
- Skills, description, and logo come from Close's [agent-plugin](https://github.com/closeio/agent-plugin) repository at commit `3e102297006a4663e65d5fa9b195569843a5c53f`.
